name: Dr. Marcus Ellington
bio: Dr. Ellington is a board-certified psychiatrist with over 28 years of clinical and academic experience in adult mood and psychotic disorders. He trained at Harvard Medical School and completed his fellowship in Psychopharmacology at Massachusetts General Hospital. He is a recognized expert in treatment-resistant depression and chairs the hospital's Neuromodulation Review Committee.

name: Dr. Priya Anandakrishnan
bio: Dr. Anandakrishnan is a double board-certified psychiatrist specializing in child, adolescent, and adult neurodevelopmental disorders with a particular focus on autism spectrum disorder and ADHD. She completed her residency at UCSF and her child psychiatry fellowship at Stanford Children's Health. Her clinical research centers on early intervention and psychosocial outcomes in ASD.

name: Dr. James Okafor
bio: Dr. Okafor is a nationally recognized authority in addiction psychiatry with three decades of clinical practice treating opioid use disorder, alcohol dependence, and co-occurring psychiatric conditions. He completed his psychiatry residency at Johns Hopkins Hospital and an addiction psychiatry fellowship at Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine. He is a principal investigator on multiple NIH-funded trials for novel medication-assisted treatment protocols.

name: Dr. Sophia Hartmann
bio: Dr. Hartmann is a board-certified psychiatrist specializing in perinatal and reproductive mental health, with expertise in managing mood and anxiety disorders during pregnancy and the postpartum period. She trained at Columbia University Irving Medical Center and completed a fellowship in Reproductive Psychiatry at Brigham and Women's Hospital. She is a co-developer of the MindCare Perinatal Wellbeing Protocol used across the hospital network.

name: Dr. Ethan Blackwell
bio: Dr. Blackwell is a board-certified forensic psychiatrist serving as the lead consultant for civil and criminal legal proceedings involving psychiatric evaluation. He completed his residency at Baylor College of Medicine and his forensic psychiatry fellowship at the University of Texas Health Science Center. He has provided expert testimony in over 200 legal cases and is a faculty member of the American Academy of Psychiatry and the Law.

name: Dr. Anika Müller
bio: Dr. Müller is a distinguished geriatric psychiatrist with 35 years of experience treating late-life depression, behavioral and psychological symptoms of dementia (BPSD), and neuropsychiatric sequelae of neurodegenerative disease. She completed her psychiatry training in Germany before subspecialty fellowship training at Massachusetts General Hospital. She is internationally recognized for her work on deprescribing and minimizing polypharmacy in elderly psychiatric patients.

name: Dr. Rafael Dominguez
bio: Dr. Dominguez is a board-certified psychiatrist and early psychosis intervention specialist with expertise in Coordinated Specialty Care for first-episode psychosis and schizophrenia spectrum disorders. He completed his residency at the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine and his fellowship at the NIMH Early Psychosis Research Center. He leads the MindCare First Episode Psychosis Clinic and is an active contributor to the RAISE implementation program.

name: Dr. Yuki Tanaka
bio: Dr. Tanaka is a dual-trained psychiatrist and sleep medicine physician specializing in the bidirectional relationship between sleep disorders and psychiatric illness, particularly in mood and anxiety disorders. She completed her psychiatry residency at the University of Washington and a fellowship in Behavioral Sleep Medicine at the Stanford Center for Human Sleep Research. She is a board-certified sleep medicine physician and chairs the hospital's Insomnia Clinic.

name: Dr. Christopher Adeyemi
bio: Dr. Adeyemi is a board-certified psychiatrist specializing in bipolar spectrum disorders, treatment-resistant depression, and mood stabilization pharmacotherapy. He completed his residency and mood disorders fellowship at Emory University School of Medicine, where he remains an adjunct associate professor. He has authored over 40 peer-reviewed publications on lithium therapeutics and ketamine augmentation strategies.

name: Dr. Leila Shirazi
bio: Dr. Shirazi is a board-certified psychiatrist specializing in the medical and psychiatric management of eating disorders across the severity spectrum, from outpatient treatment to medical hospitalization. She completed her residency at UCLA Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior and her eating disorders fellowship at the UCSD Eating Disorders Center for Treatment and Research. She is a certified practitioner in Family-Based Treatment (FBT) for adolescent anorexia nervosa.
